label: REAL PROFILES written by gpt-4.1-mini from real Census draws. The residents are simulated; the stereotype review here is keyword heuristics only, no LLM review was run.

census.source: ACS 2024 5 year PUMS (2020 to 2024), Census API (https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5/pums)

homes.source: tract counts: ACS 2024 5 year B01003, B03002, B25008, B26001, Census API; tracts in the PUMA: Census 2020 tract to PUMA relationship file; population centers: Census 2020; neighborhoods: City of Syracuse open data
homes.method: tract drawn with probability proportional to people in the tract with the resident's race and Hispanic origin times the tract's share with the resident's tenure (treated as independent within a tract; all ages); neighborhood is the one containing the tract's population center

profiles.llm_review: not run, to stay within the cap of one real call per profile

known_defects: Known defects of this run, found after it: (1) the 20 residents were drawn before records were sorted, and the Census API returns rows in a new order on each request, so --seed 0 now draws a different 20; the 20 records and profiles are kept in data/processed/town/residents_real.json. (2) The prompt sent income as a bare 'income' field; one profile called the annual figure monthly. The prompt now sends annual_income_dollars. Regenerating needs 20 more real calls, beyond the cap for this run.
